name: List All Work Order Attachments
description: Returns all attachments associated with a work order

queryFilters.name: filters[WorkOrderId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the work order. All GET requests must include a filter for [WorkOrderId], or [CreatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[CreatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter attachments created at or after this date-time.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of work order attachment objects

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name given to describe the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].ContentType
responseFields.description: The content type of the work order attachment. An example content type is a photo or a PDF.

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the work order attachment was created by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the work order associated with the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].WorkOrderId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the work order associated with the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].URL
responseFields.description: The link to download the file in the attachment

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
